title: Determinants of Radiation Dermatitis in Head and Neck Cancer Patients Receiving Preventive Photobiomodulation
official: Prospective Cohort Evaluating the Determinants of Radiation-Induced Skin Complications in Patients With Head and Neck Cancer Receiving Preventive Photobiomodulation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older at the time of inclusion
* Diagnosis of head and neck cancer (histological, cytological or imaging confirmation), including the following sites: oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, larynx, nasopharynx, nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses
* Indication for curative-intent external beam radiotherapy (exclusive or adjuvant), with or without concomitant chemotherapy, exposing the cervical skin
* Possibility of starting preventive photobiomodulation (PBM) from the start of radiotherapy according to the standardized protocol (3 sessions/week, 3 J/cm2)
* Affiliated with or beneficiary of a social security scheme
* Free, informed and express written consent obtained after provision of an information sheet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to receive PBM due to a contraindication, patient refusal, or radiotherapy duration of less than two weeks
* Previous radiotherapy to the cervico-facial region
* Uncontrolled or active dermatological condition in the area to be irradiated likely to interfere with the assessment of skin toxicity (psoriasis, eczema, cutaneous lupus, etc.)
* Ongoing photosensitizing treatment that cannot be interrupted or replaced during radiotherapy
* Severe immunosuppression, defined in particular as HIV infection at the AIDS stage, long-term immunosuppressive treatment, or history of organ transplantation
* Concurrent participation in another therapeutic trial likely to affect the occurrence or severity of skin toxicity
* Person under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship or safeguard of justice)
* Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
* Patient refusal to participate in the study
